verdict.rationale: skills.sh covers all three routes in the story. Skills install by default to a project-scoped `./<agent>/skills/` directory that is documented as "committed with your project, shared with team". The CLI also installs from shared GitHub, GitLab, Azure and private repos using existing git auth, and skills.sh offers a public skills directory, the Skills Leaderboard. Team rollout is backed by non-interactive CI-friendly installs and restore from `skills-lock.json`, and a runtime probe confirmed keyless, promptless installs and repo listing. Missing for 10: clearly stable version pinning (the lockfile restore is labeled `experimental_install` in some docs) and independent hands-on evidence of a full team-wide rollout.
